title: Analista de infraestrutura
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional experiente em Infraestrutura de TI para atuar na administração e sustentação de ambientes corporativos críticos, com foco em servidores, virtualização, backup e suporte de alto nível.

Se você tem perfil analítico, gosta de resolver problemas complexos e atuar em ambientes robustos de tecnologia, essa oportunidade pode ser para você!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Administração de servidores Windows e Linux (RedHat) .
  • Gestão de ambientes de virtualização (VMware e Hyper-V) .
  • Administração de storages HP, Hitachi e servidores Blades .
  • Gerenciamento das rotinas de backup utilizando NetBackup .
  • Administração e suporte de telefonia corporativa (Skype e Teams) .
  • Suporte de 3º nível para usuários internos em hardware, software, telefonia e ambiente Citrix .
  • Suporte à infraestrutura de TI , incluindo nobreaks, geradores e cabeamento estruturado .
  • Monitoramento do ambiente de produção utilizando ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Administração de DFS, SCCM e ferramentas de e-mail .
  • Gestão do sistema de gravação e dealerboard .
  • Administração do site de contingência e People Center .
  • Elaboração e atualização da documentação da infraestrutura de TI .
  • Participação em projetos de infraestrutura e design tecnológico das agências .
  • Comunicação direta com times e escritórios regionais .
  • Apoio na aquisição de servidores, dispositivos de rede e itens de infraestrutura .
  • Garantir a aplicação de processos de governança e políticas de TI da organização.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em infraestrutura de TI , preferencialmente no segmento bancário ou financeiro .
  • Conhecimento avançado em Windows Server (certificação será diferencial).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Linux Server (RedHat) .
  • Experiência com virtualização (VMware e Hyper-V) .
  • Conhecimentos em Citrix .
  • Conhecimento em DFS .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de backup (NetBackup) .
  • Conhecimentos em telecom e redes : switches, roteadores, VLAN e links de dados.
  • Conhecimento em SCCM .
  • Experiência com telefonia corporativa (Skype / Teams) .
  • Conhecimento em administração de storages e servidores Blade .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento como SCOM, HPOpenView for Linux, Fluke NetFlow, Cacti e NNMi .
  • Capacidade analítica e habilidade para diagnóstico e resolução de problemas complexos .

⭐ Diferenciais

  • Certificação ITIL V3 .
  • Conhecimentos em infraestrutura elétrica básica (Nobreaks, Geradores, NR10) .
  • Experiência em processos de aquisição de hardware e infraestrutura .
  • Experiência em ambientes corporativos de grande porte .

Perfil que buscamos

  • Profissional organizado, com visão de infraestrutura corporativa.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com equipes e escritórios internacionais.
  • Capacidade de atuar em projetos estratégicos de TI e ambientes críticos.

title: Senior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

Overview of the role:

Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.

Key responsibilities:

- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.

Requirements:

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.

Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.

If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Sales Enablement Specialist, Digital Course & Access Programs
description:
JoVE is the world-leading producer and provider of science video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.

The Role

JoVE is seeking a Sales Enablement Specialist - Digital Course Materials & Access Programs to support the operational delivery and adoption of JoVE’s digital science video platform across higher education institutions.

This role sits within the Sales Enablement team and focuses on managing course material adoptions, supporting bookstore affordability programs such as Inclusive Access and Equitable Access, and ensuring the reliable delivery of JoVE content through Learning Management Systems (LMS).

While JoVE’s Customer Success team works directly with faculty on course-level implementation, this role focuses on operational workflows, adoption tracking, data analysis, and identifying trends or systemic issues affecting digital course material delivery.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational and analytical skills with meaningful experience working with LMS platforms and LTI-based integrations used in higher education courseware delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage course material adoptions and digital product fulfillment across higher education accounts.
  • Support the implementation and administration of Inclusive Access and Equitable Access programs with university bookstores.
  • Coordinate course setup and delivery of digital materials through bookstore distribution systems.
  • Analyze sales, adoption, and fulfillment data to create reports and dashboards that support forecasting, planning, and decision-making.
  • Provide insights to Sales leadership on adoption performance and program growth.
  • Identify trends, gaps, and opportunities in bookstore and digital distribution workflows.
  • Monitor workflows that support JoVE content delivery through Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, D2L, etc.). Recommend process improvements and system enhancements to support scalable program delivery.
  • Apply working knowledge of LTI integrations and LMS courseware delivery models to diagnose access or authentication issues.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor’s degree
  • 3+ years experience in EdTech, digital publishing, sales operations, or academic technology environments
  • Strong familiarity with Learning Management Systems (Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, Brightspace, etc.)
  • Demonstrated experience working with LTI integrations or LMS-based courseware delivery
  • Strong experience using Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
  • Results-driven, strong organization and analytical skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment

Why JoVE?

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us

Esta posição tem foco na edição de vídeos e criação em motion design para campanhas, redes sociais, cursos e eventos, atuando na adaptação de conteúdos para diferentes canais, desenvolvimento de animações e melhoria contínua das entregas, em parceria com áreas internas. title: Executivo de Parceiros (outbound)
description:
Executivo de Parceiros (outbound) - Odoo BR

  • Modelo Híbrido - Curitiba/PR

Odoo é o principal software SaaS de Planejamento de Recursos Empresariais (ERP) de código aberto (open source) do planeta com mais de 15 milhões de usuários em todo o mundo! A Odoo fornece tecnologia que ajuda milhares de empresas no mundo inteiro a se tornarem mais eficientes.

Desenvolvido por uma comunidade global de engenheiros e especialistas de negócios de código aberto, a Odoo se tornou uma solução flexível e escalável para organizações. A Odoo está crescendo rapidamente, impulsionado por uma mentalidade focada no cliente, uma cultura de resolução criativa de problemas e a energia de uma startup.

Sobre a vaga:

O escopo de negócios do Odoo é tão amplo que você nunca parará de aprender e, com um pouco de criatividade, encontrará uma solução para a maioria dos problemas dos seus clientes. Com essa abrangência, você dominará rapidamente todos os aspectos do empreendedorismo, podendo aconselhar seus clientes como um especialista. Não se trata apenas de vendas, mas também de agregar valor aos seus clientes.

Junte-se à nossa dinâmica equipe de Executivo de Parceiros e utilize suas habilidades de prospecção, análise e negociação para construir relacionamentos positivos e expandir nossa rede de parceiros . Na prática, você interage com revendedores, integradores de sistemas, integradores de ERP e consultorias digitais de toda a região, que estejam interessados em adotar a tecnologia Odoo em seu portfólio de soluções. Como Executivo de Aquisição de Parceiros, seu objetivo é aumentar a presença global da Odoo , encontrando e convencendo novas pessoas a colaborar conosco, vender e implementar o Odoo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Busque parceiros por conta própria em diferentes plataformas, crie sua própria rede de potenciais parceiros e desenvolva sua estratégia para alcançar diversas empresas.
  • Iniciar contato e qualificar potenciais parceiros; compreender seus negócios, capacidades, valores e processos para garantir que estejam alinhados com nosso modelo de negócios.
  • Analisar e compreender o perfil do parceiro, seus desafios, dificuldades e necessidades de negócios, e determinar como podemos construir uma relação mutuamente benéfica.
  • Apresente o produto fornecendo uma demonstração personalizada do Odoo.
  • Apresentar orçamento e negociar as condições de colaboração.

Qualificação :

  • Obrigatório: Inglês avançado.
  • Conhecimento de negócios e curiosidade
  • Capacidade de pensar fora da caixa
  • Resiliência e perseverança
  • Interesse e/ou experiência em Vendas
  • Interesse em TI e software

Diferenciais:

  • Bacharelado em Administração de Empresas ou similares
  • Habilidades analíticas
  • Experiência prévia em TI ou venda de soluções.
  • Espírito de caça e atividade profissional
  • Comunicador convincente

Benefícios da Odoo:

  • VT (de acordo com a sua necessidade) com desconto de até 6% sobre seu salário;
  • Seguro de Vida (múltiplo salarial de 12x);

title: Técnico de Automação (PLC/IHM)
description:

  • Programação, configuração e manutenção de PLCs industriais (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider ou equivalentes).

  • Experiência com programação ou manutenção de PLCs (Siemens, Rockwell, Schneider ou similares).
  • Experiência com configuração de IHMs industriais.
  • Conhecimento em redes industriais e protocolos de comunicação (Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP ou similares).

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

title: Consultor Técnico - PJ
description:

Esta posição é ideal para profissionais que, além da atuação comercial, exercem papel fundamental na demonstração técnica, aplicação prática, treinamentos e suporte técnico das tecnologias junto a médicos e equipes clínicas. A função exige domínio técnico aprofundado, contato direto com profissionais da saúde e participação ativa em demonstrações, capacitações e suporte pós-venda, atuando como referência técnica da marca junto aos clientes.

Atuação técnica (essencial):

  • Realizar demonstrações práticas e técnicas dos equipamentos médicos em clínicas, consultórios e eventos;
  • Conduzir apresentações técnicas aprofundadas, explicando funcionamento, protocolos, indicações, diferenciais e segurança das tecnologias;
  • Executar treinamentos técnicos de usabilidade para médicos e equipes após a venda (presencial e online);
  • Apoiar clientes na aplicação correta das tecnologias, garantindo aderência aos protocolos e melhor performance dos equipamentos;
  • Gerenciar inventário, transporte, controle e logística dos equipamentos utilizados para demonstração.

Atuação em Vendas (consultiva):

  • Atuar com vendas consultivas, conectando necessidades clínicas às soluções tecnológicas;
  • Prospectar novos clientes por meio de visitas técnicas, networking e mídias sociais;
  • Conduzir negociações, elaborar propostas comerciais e acompanhar todo o ciclo de vendas;
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com médicos, clínicas, afiliados, embaixadores e speakers;
  • Participar de congressos, eventos médicos, workshops, ações promocionais e lives.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo - Em Biomedicina ou Fisioterapia;
  • Experiência prévia com vendas ou atendimento consultivo (diferencial forte);
  • Experiência clínica com utilização de equipamentos e tecnologias médicas/estéticas (Laser de CO2 Fracionado, Érbium, Thulium, Ultrasom Micro e Macro Focado, Radiofrequência Microagulhada, Criolipólise)
  • CNH categoria B e veículo próprio;
  • Perfil comercial aliado à boa comunicação, didática e habilidade para demonstrações técnicas;
  • Facilidade em ensinar, apresentar e conduzir treinamentos;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e participação em eventos;
  • Interesse contínuo em aprendizado e desenvolvimento profissional.

title: Data Architect - Snowflake || Brazil/Remote
description:
Data Architect – Snowflake

Advance hands-on SQL

Responsibilities

• Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and mentorship to a team of data engineers, ensuring best practices in coding, architecture, and data operations.

• End-to-End Ownership: Architect, implement, and optimize end-to-end data pipelines that process and transform large-scale datasets efficiently and reliably.

• Orchestration and Automation: Design scalable workflows using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, ensuring high availability and fault tolerance.

• Data Warehouse and Lake Optimization: Lead the implementation and optimization of Snowflake and data lake technologies like Apache Iceberg for storage, query performance, and scalability.

• Real-Time and Batch Processing: Build robust systems leveraging Kafka, SQS, or similar messaging technologies for real-time and batch data processing.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Data Science, Product, and Engineering teams to define data requirements and deliver actionable insights.

• Data Governance and Security: Establish and enforce data governance frameworks, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and maintaining data integrity.

• Scalability and Performance: Develop strategies to optimize performance for systems processing terabytes of data daily while ensuring scalability.

• Team Building: Foster a collaborative team environment, driving skill development, career growth, and continuous learning within the team.

• Innovation and Continuous Improvement: Stay ahead of industry trends to evaluate and incorporate new tools, technologies, and methodologies into the organization.

Qualifications

Required Skills:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering with a proven track record of leading data projects or teams.

• Strong programming skills in Python, with expertise in building and optimizing ETL pipelines.

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.

• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.

• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.

• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.

• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.

• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

• Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, including version control, deployment strategies, and automated testing.

• Proven experience working in an Agile development environment and managing cross-functional team interactions.

• Strong background in data modeling, data governance, and ensuring compliance with data security standards.

• Experience working with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or GCP.

Preferred Skills:

• Proficiency in stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink for real-time analytics.

• Familiarity with programming languages like Scala or Java for additional engineering tasks.

• Exposure to integrating data pipelines with machine learning workflows.

• Strong analytical skills to evaluate new technologies and tools for scalability and performance.

Leadership Skills:

• Proven ability to lead and mentor data engineering teams, promoting collaboration and a culture of excellence.

• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to articulate complex technical concepts to stakeholders.

• Strategic thinking to align data engineering efforts with business goals and objectives.

title: Systems Engineer
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world.

This role will cover either our open B (4PM - 12PM) and C (12PM-8AM) shift as well as weekends.

Job Summary:

The Systems Engineer is responsible for leading the deployment of complete systems that include Clever Devices products combined with complementary technologies, including deployment of hardware products and interfaces, to provide a holistic solution that meets customer requirements.

The Systems Engineer works closely with the project team to analyze the customer requirements and required functionality early in the project cycle; create design documents, system architecture, requirement matrix and support the customer design reviews, conduct the Factory Acceptance Testing with the customer and lead the subsequent deployment at the Customer site. Execute and complete the System Acceptance Testing along with the customer and all other parties involved in the project

The Systems Engineer coordinates all system development and integration tasks to include design, integration and formal testing. The Systems Engineer also works to support the Systems Engineering team.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supports the definition of software and hardware products and interfaces
  • Coordinates system development tasks to include design, integration and formal testing
  • Oversees all transitions into customer’s deployment
  • Develops and completes projects in system specifications, technical and logistical requirements and other disciplines
  • Creates and maintains programmatic and technical documentation (design docs, requirement matrix, system diagrams, etc) to insure efficient planning and execution
  • Manages and documents system configurations
  • Ensures the deployment of the solution is successful
  • Maintains a thorough working knowledge of enterprise applications such as BusTime and CleverCAD
  • Implements Performance analysis and reliability analysis of the end to end protocol
  • Adheres to protocol revisions and amendments as directed by the Regional Systems Engineering Manager
  • Assists in other tasks as needed by the Systems Engineering department
  • Provides training and guidance to Associates, Project Engineer I/II as needed.

Skills Required:

  • 10+ years experience in engineering development
  • 10+ years experience in systems engineering involving hardware, software, data and communications technologies
  • Good understanding of the J1939 and J1708 protocols and experience with Multiplex systems
  • Hardware design experience and ability to read electrical schematics
  • Experience with hardware troubleshooting and lab equipment
  • Experience with network and protocol troubleshooting and tools
  • Working knowledge of one or more of the following: C and C++, SQL, VB, JavaScript, HTML, ASP, python, databases, report generation and networking
  • Ability to independently gather and document requirements and provide design requirements and product definition
  • Strong computer skills particularly with MS Office including Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint and Project.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize
  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Bachelors Degree in Engineering or Computer Engineering required, Masters Degree in related discipline.
  • Experience working with public transit is a plus

Clever Devices is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer

title: IT Support Analyst
description:
(We never request payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates through our official accounts and corporate platforms. If you are asked to make a payment, it is likely a scam. Please check to see if the position you are interested in is posted here on our website.)

TMF Group is a leading provider of administrative services, helping clients invest and operate securely around the world. As a global company with over 11,000 employees across more than 125 offices in 87 jurisdictions, we seek talented individuals with the potential to thrive at TMF Group, regardless of their background, and we offer career opportunities to the widest possible range of people. Once on board, we nurture and promote talented individuals, ensuring that leadership roles are within everyone’s reach.

Discover the Role

The role is dedicated to maintaining high-quality IT services and ensuring the efficient operation of users' devices and office technology. Collaboration with internal customers is essential to guarantee adherence to IT processes, maximize the benefit of technology solutions, and provide clear guidance regarding technological advancements.

The support team is expected to demonstrate organization, attention to detail, and a strong customer focus. Team members are responsible for supporting the global IT team by serving as local representatives for IT support and follow the best practices under ITSM framework.

Main Responsibilities

Provide expert-level user support, ensuring high availability, stability, and performance of IT services while acting as an escalation point for complex or high-impact issues.

  • Lead and coordinate the maintenance, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of end-user workplace (user and office devices) acting as a key interface with the global IT organization and external vendors.
  • Own and govern TMF’s IT asset management processes, ensuring data accuracy, compliance, and continuous improvement across inventory tracking and audits.
  • Manage and resolve complex incidents and service requests, applying strong root cause analysis and ensuring timely, high-quality resolutions aligned with SLA and KPI targets.
  • Coordinate escalations, follow-ups, and on-site support activities as required.
  • Oversee onboarding and offboarding technical activities, ensuring secure, standardized, and efficient device provisioning, recovery, and handover processes.
  • Contribute actively to local and global IT initiatives, including technology rollouts, process improvements, and automation efforts, providing technical leadership and local ownership.
  • Proactively identify, assess, and report security risks, threats, and vulnerabilities, reinforcing a strong security-first mindset and supporting compliance with corporate and regulatory standards.
  • Own the incident and service request queue, ensuring proper prioritization, workload balancing, SLA adherence, and continuous flow optimization across the support team.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and day-to-day guidance to junior and mid-level support engineers, fostering skills development and consistent service quality.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated proficiency with Windows operating systems and Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, and Teams.
  • Solid understanding of networking principles such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VPN setup.
  • Knowledgeable in managing user accounts and groups within Active Directory.
  • Highly organized and focused on delivering effective solutions balancing risk, urgency and quality.
  • Customer‑centric and service‑driven mindset showing empathy, ownership and professionalism.
  • Communicates confidently and clearly with stakeholders at all levels, translating technical concepts into understandable guidance and collaborating effectively within a multicultural, global IT organization.
  • Familiarity with ITSM framework.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.
  • Spanish will be considered as a plus.

Nossa presença global em mais de 80 países permite que você influencie a maneira como diversos clientes globais fazem negócios, bem como retribuir as comunidades globais em que operamos.

Seja parte do One TMF

Na TMF Group, nosso pessoal é o que nos torna quem somos. Nossa empresa prospera com o espírito empreendedor de pessoas proativas que combinam entusiasmo com responsabilidade e prestação de contas.

Um mundo de oportunidades

Independentemente de onde você esteja em sua carreira, a TMF Group abre um mundo de oportunidades onde você fará parte de nossa equipe e receberá suporte em sua jornada profissional.

title: Merchant Operations Manager
description:
About the Role

As a Merchant Operations Manager, you will be at the forefront of ensuring flawless merchant operations. You will create scalable tools and processes to support local teams in achieving outstanding experience targets. This role requires daily interaction with City Leads and Account Managers, a deep understanding of key merchants, and the ability to extract actionable insights that drive mid-term strategies, making every delivery great.

What You'll Do

  • Merchant Operations : Work closely with commercial teams to identify key operational opportunities and reduce defects, driving continuous improvement across the merchant base.
  • End-to-End Project Management : Lead cross-functional projects from scoping to delivery, using structured project management methods to plan & execute key projects idenpendently toward clear business goals.
  • Problem Solving : Identify root causes of risks and opportunities, develop multiple actionable solutions, and evaluate tradeoffs to recommend the best path forward.
  • Process Optimization : Execute, optimize, and scale core analyses and processes — establishing standardized workflows that improve team efficiency and are regularly reviewed for performance.
  • Product & Tool Development : Identify merchant needs and pain points; partner with product and Product teams to support the implementation from merchant/sales-side tools and capabilities that improve online operational efficiency.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with commercial teams to understand pain points and identify system and process improvements with local & global team members.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience : At least 5 years of professional experience in merchant operations, delivery roles, logistics, business operations, strategy operations, or related field.
  • End-to-End Ownership : Demonstrated ability to lead projects from conception through execution, coordinating across strategy, product, and operations teams to deliver results idependently.
  • Execution Excellence : Ability to manage and prioritize complex workstreams, collaborate across teams, and deliver results in a fast-paced, evolving environment while maintaining high standards.
  • Data-Driven Mindset : Ability to make strategic decisions based on data analysis. Comfortable working deeply with data while maintaining a big-picture perspective. Strong critical thinking and analytical skills, with experience in reporting, experimentation, and scaling processes or products.
  • Planning & Organization : Experience managing complex, cross-functional projects, including defining timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and resource allocation.
  • Communication : Proficiency in English. Ability to clearly interpret and present data to diverse audiences in an engaging and concise way.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical Skills : Strong SQL and Excel skills. Experience with databases or programming languages such as SQL & Python is a plus.
  • 0-to-1 Experience: Track record of building processes, tools, or products from scratch in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Industry Background : Prior experience in food delivery, e-commerce, or startup within operations industries is preferred.

title: Credit Risk Underwriter - Sr. Associate
description:
About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early-stage start-up investment and M&A/joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non-bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you're passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi-cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let's contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Credit Underwriting & Execution

  • Lead the end-to-end underwriting process for the company’s credit products, ensuring applications are reviewed, analyzed, and documented according to internal credit policies.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis of borrower information, credit bureau data, financial capacity, and behavioral indicators to support sound approve/reject decisions.
  • Prepare structured credit memos and recommendation reports for internal review and committee discussion.
  • Ensure consistency, quality, and auditability across all underwriting decisions.

Credit Policy Implementation & Continuous Improvement

  • Translate credit policies and guidelines into practical underwriting workflows, checklists, and decision frameworks.
  • Support the implementation of new credit products from launch phase to scale, ensuring underwriting processes are robust, efficient, and aligned with risk appetite.
  • Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities in underwriting procedures and propose enhancements.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and provide feedback loops to refine credit criteria, eligibility rules, and approval standards.

Portfolio Analytics & Credit Policy Interpretation

  • Interpret the portfolio analytics outputs produced by the Data AVP (vintage analysis, PD/LGD back testing, score migration matrices) and translate them into actionable credit policy adjustment proposals: cutoff recalibration, rate tier shifts, eligibility criteria refinements.
  • Prepare quarterly portfolio review packages for the credit committee, including performance summaries, model monitoring metrics, and recommended policy actions with supporting analysis.
  • Monitor portfolio concentration risk, sector exposure, and early warning indicators on an ongoing basis. Escalate emerging risks and propose mitigation actions to Credit Risk AVP.

Portfolio Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track key credit performance indicators, including approval rates, delinquency trends, and early warning signals.
  • Prepare recurring portfolio analysis and performance reports for internal stakeholders and credit committees.
  • Escalate emerging risks and recommend corrective actions when needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Risk, Data, Operations, and Business teams to ensure smooth execution of credit processes.
  • Support documentation and governance standards related to underwriting and credit decisioning.
  • Contribute to building the company’s credit knowledge base as new products and processes are developed.

Requirements

  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, Accounting, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3–6 years of experience in credit underwriting, credit policy, or credit risk analysis within a fintech, finance company, SCD, or bank.
  • Proven hands-on experience leading underwriting processes for a structured credit product. Experience with secured lending / regulated lending products is a strong plus.
  • Strong knowledge of credit analysis fundamentals: bureau interpretation, income and affordability assessment, risk segmentation, decision documentation and regulatory requirements.
  • Solid Excel skills and comfort working with data to support credit decisions and portfolio monitoring. Exposure to BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of ECL methodology, familiarity with BCB frameworks. Knowledge of FIDC structures is a strong plus.
  • Strong written communication skills for producing credit policy documents, regulatory-grade reports, and committee materials. Comfortable reading and challenging credit models from a credit judgment perspective.
  • Ability to operate independently, structure processes, and bring practical solutions in a fast-growing environment. High sense of ownership, accountability, and execution focus.

description:
Company Description

Welcome to Avenues São Paulo! Since our doors opened in August 2018, we've been on a mission to provide a truly transformative educational experience. Through immersive English language learning and dynamic interdisciplinary projects, we prepare our students to become future worldwise leaders uniquely equipped to understand and solve global-scale problems. As part of the Nord Anglia Education network, we're proud to stand alongside Avenues New York, shaping the future of education together. With a vibrant community of over 1100 students, ranging from as young as 18 months old through to graduation, our campus buzzes with a culture of innovation, creativity, collaboration, and state-of-the-art technology. Join us as we embark on a journey of lifelong learning and growth and discover why there's no place quite like Avenues São Paulo.

Job Description

This role blends analytical skills with a strong understanding of digital content and marketing to create, plan, implement, and optimize content strategies that drive brand positioning and enrollment growth. Reporting directly to the Content Marketing Manager, this role is integral to supporting the Marketing team at the São Paulo campus, ensuring that all content aligns with Avenues’ mission and branding philosophies, with strong ownership over Avenues São Paulo’s digital content presence and a high standard of editorial judgment and strategic thinking.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for developing and managing implementation schedules and strategic actions to ensure timely and effective content delivery across channels (including social media, email campaigns, website, and blog articles) in alignment with overall marketing objectives.
  • Monitors, collects, and analyzes performance data (traffic, engagement, conversions, etc.) across channels to produce comprehensive reports with actionable insights and recommendations for content optimization and campaign improvements.
  • Creates, publishes, and manages written and visual content tailored to different audiences, in the form of website updates, blog articles, email marketing, social media posts/messages, campaigns etc, ensuring alignment with Avenues’ brand, tone, and marketing objectives.
  • Owns the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of digital content across platforms, ensuring high editorial standards and strategic alignment with enrollment and brand objectives.
  • Conducts competitive research and monitors public sentiment and digital trends to identify opportunities for differentiation, growth, and audience engagement.
  • Manages and maintains a content calendar to ensure timely, strategic, and consistent content delivery aligned with marketing initiatives and key admissions dates and events.
  • Supports multimedia content production, including video and photo shooting and editing, to deliver high-quality, impactful digital assets.
  • Monitors and manages the online community by responding to comments, messages, and inquiries, fostering positive interactions and building an engaged digital audience.
  • Collaborates with external PR and marketing agencies to ensure alignment of our messaging, strategy, and goals.
  • Engages with faculty and academic teams to understand classroom experiences and learning practices, translating them into accurate, compelling, and authentic content narratives.
  • Collaborates closely with Admissions and Marketing to interpret content performance in relation to enrollment goals, supporting data-informed decisions across the admissions funnel.
  • Continuously monitors trends in content marketing, social media, and digital analytics, translating insights and performance data into strategic evolution of content formats, channels, and narratives.

Qualifications

  • Fluent in both Portuguese and English.
  • Strong editorial judgment and the ability to write, edit, and adapt high-quality content fluently in both English and Portuguese for different audiences and channels.
  • Solid experience in a Marketing and Social Media role.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Suite, including Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, and Premiere.
  • A degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong Verbal and Written Communication Skills.
  • Experience using CRM and analytics tools (such as HubSpot and Salesforce) to inform content strategy and performance optimization.
  • Experience with Google Ads/Analytics, Meta, CRM, and SEO.
  • Extreme attention to detail and organization with proven project management skills, from ideation to completion in a fast-growing, quick-moving environment, and the ability to prioritize.
  • A desire to work as part of a highly collaborative and can-do team, a hands-on, entrepreneurial approach, and eager to roll up your sleeves and tackle challenges.
  • A results-oriented, collaborative approach to project management.
  • Experience in education is desirable but not required. A strong interest in school routines and innovative educational methodologies is essential.

Avenues is deeply committed to diversity, equity and inclusion throughout our organization. We strive to uphold a culture in which every colleague feels that they belong, are trusted, and are valued. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented communities or groups to apply. Avenues offers competitive compensation and a generous benefits package.

title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.

Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals , and earn money from your network.

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.

Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.

Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic "overnarrating".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying "Debug Info" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.

Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

title: Merchant Risk Management Expert
description:
As a Merchant Risk Management Expert , you will be the strategic gatekeeper for our merchant ecosystem in Brazil. Your mission is to oversee the entire merchant lifecycle, from initial qualification to dynamic, real-time monitoring. You will play a pivotal role in balancing business growth with robust risk mitigation, ensuring that our operations not only meet but exceed the regulatory standards of the Brazilian Central Bank.

  • Strategic Interfacing: Act as the primary risk consultant for our internal business teams and external merchant partners. You will represent the "voice of risk" in commercial discussions, ensuring a smooth balance between security and scalability.

Requirements

  • Expertise: Minimum of 3+ years of experience in risk management, specifically within cross-border e-commerce or international acquiring institutions .
  • Regulatory Mastery: Deep, up-to-date knowledge of Brazilian local policies and regulations (Central Bank). You must have the ability to swiftly pivot strategies in response to regulatory changes.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Finance, Computer Science, Economics, or a related field.
  • Communication & Culture: Proven ability to collaborate across diverse, global teams. You are comfortable navigating cross-cultural environments and can translate complex risk data into actionable business insights.
  • Language: Fluent English is mandatory, as it is our primary working language for global collaboration.
  • Problem Solver: A resilient and pragmatic mindset, with a track record of resolving complex, high-stakes risk issues.

Why Ant International?

We are a global leader in digital payments and financial technology. Joining us means working at the intersection of massive scale and local impact. You will have the opportunity to build the future of financial inclusion while working with some of the most advanced risk management technologies in the world.

description:
Head de Capítulo - Engenharia de Detecção e Resposta

Nossa operação de Managed Security Services (MSS) alcançou um novo patamar de maturidade e escala no Brasil. Para sustentar esse crescimento acelerado e manter o nível de excelência exigido por clientes de ambientes críticos, estamos evoluindo nossa estrutura organizacional para o modelo de Capítulos de Especialidade.

Nesse contexto, buscamos profissionais preparados para assumir um papel de liderança técnica e estratégica, atuando como Head de Capítulo, com responsabilidade direta sobre pessoas, qualidade técnica, evolução de capacidades e interface com clientes e stakeholders globais.

A UPX é referência latino-americana em proteção de borda, observabilidade e Managed Security Services, com mais de 22 anos protegendo infraestruturas críticas e operações de alta disponibilidade.

  • Atuação comprovada em operação ou estruturação de Provedores de Serviços de Segurança Gerenciados;
  • Familiaridade com modelos de SLA, processos operacionais, precificação e métricas.

✅ Conhecimento técnico em soluções:

  • Crowdstrike: Endpoint Protection, EDR/XDR, gestão de incidentes;
  • Google Chronicle SIEM: Coleta, retenção e análise de logs e eventos de segurança;
  • Soluções complementares: Firewall, WAF, Zero Trust, IAM, entre outras.

✅ Operação e gestão de SOC:

  • Gestão de equipes SOC (Tier 1, 2 e 3);
  • Domínio em processos de triagem, investigação e resposta a incidentes.

✅ Inteligência de ameaças:

  • OSINT, plataformas como Recorded Future, MISP, Anomali, etc.

✅ Estruturas de segurança cibernética:

  • NIST CSF, MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001/27002, CIS Controls.

✅ Conformidade e regulatório:

  • LGPD, GDPR, PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC2.

✅ Gestão de Incidentes Críticos:

  • Experiência com ransomware, APTs, DDoS, vazamentos de dados, etc.

2. Habilidades Gerenciais e Comportamentais

  • Visão estratégica e foco em novos negócios;
  • Liderança de equipes técnicas, recrutamento e desenvolvimento de talentos;
  • Apoio à equipe comercial com visão técnica e presença em negociações;
  • Comunicação eficaz com diferentes níveis (clientes, diretoria, stakeholders);
  • Resiliência, flexibilidade e capacidade de entrega sob pressão;
  • Gestão de múltiplos projetos com metodologias ágeis ou tradicionais.

3. Qualificações Obrigatórias e Desejáveis

Obrigatórias:

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia (qualquer especialidade);

Desejáveis:

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Cibersegurança ou Gestão de TI.
  • Certificações de segurança (desejáveis, mas não obrigatórias): CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, Crowdstrike Falcon, Google Chronicle, SANS/GIAC, CTIA.

Sobre a UPX:

A UPX está há duas décadas no mercado, é referência em mitigação de ataques DDoS, e destaque no monitoramento, identificação, tratamento, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo (CDN e Streaming) com elevado desempenho. Está presente em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), tem em seu portfólio grandes clientes do setor bancário e financeiro, operadoras de telecom e provedores de internet (ISP).

Atua combatendo ataques, vulnerabilidades e ameaças cibernéticas com apoio de um time técnico de Segurança da Informação e Engenharia de Redes que operam por meio de SOC (Security Operations Center), NOC (Network Operations Center) e Scrubbing Centers (Centros de Mitigação).

title: Estagiário de finanças
description:

Para nós 10 minutos é tempo de sobra para você preparar ou receber refeições deliciosas e saudáveis!

A Cumbuca Boa é um e-commerce que oferece comida ultracongelada, saudável e deliciosa. Que nasceu para democratizar o acesso a uma alimentação de qualidade e quebrar de vez o tabu da comida congelada, acredite se quiser… Ou melhor, experimente e dê sua opinião!

A Piadina Romagnola é o resultado de um sonho antigo de construir uma empresa no ramo da alimentação. Nela oferecemos um sanduíche delicioso e tradicional, a Piadina, muito mais saudável e equilibrado que as opções mais comuns. Fundada em 2012 com a primeira unidade no Morumbi Shopping, atua hoje em 14 unidades localizadas em alguns do melhores pontos da cidade de São Paulo, atendendo cerca de 80.000 clientes/mês.

Tanto na Cumbuca quanto na Piadina nossa missão é uma só: encantar nossos clientes todos os dias através de uma alimentação deliciosa, saudável e prática.

Nossos principais ingredientes são amor e carinho.

Para sonhar com o nosso apetite de crescimento, precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha experiência ou deseje aprender sobre área de Operações. Alguém que tenha conhecimento, pró atividade e discernimento para, com o passar do tempo, prever e antecipar demandas e próximos passos.

Objetivo

O objetivo é oferecer suporte analítico á diretoria da empresa. Com análises, estudos e acompanhamento de projetos.

Nessa posição

Precisamos de uma pessoa que tenha talento com números. Você será o responsável por dar suporte ao time financeiro, tendo como principais atribuições:

Contas a Pagar e Receber: Auxiliar nos lançamentos de contas a pagar, acompanhar processos de aprovação de despesas, registrar informações no sistema ERP e realizar efetivações bancárias.

title: (Contract) Psychologist
description:
Part-Time Mental Health Therapist (Hybrid: Remote & In-Person)

Location: São José dos Campos, São Paulo, Brazil

City: São José dos Campos, São Paulo

Our mission: to eliminate every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is the leading comprehensive mental health benefit for employers. We help employees understand their mental health issues and connect with best-in-class providers to get the right treatment at the right time.

From early detection to full recovery, Spring Health is the only clinically validated solution in the market proven to be more effective than traditional mental healthcare. By combining the latest technology with vetted providers, we help engage 1 in 3 employees, reduce recovery times, and lower healthcare costs. We are an award-winning, passionate, and mission-driven team with the support of leaders in psychiatry.

We are seeking qualified, part-time internationally licensed psychotherapists to join our provider network and deliver care with a tech-enabled, AI/machine-learning platform that puts patient outcomes first.

What You'll Do

  • Provide counseling to clients with benefits ranging from short-term goal-focused EAP, to employer health plans allowing as many sessions as medically necessary.
  • Treat adults who have completed brief, evidence-based online screenings identifying their symptoms and areas of concern.
  • Preferably, also be open to treating additional populations such as children, adolescents, couples, or families.
  • Maintain a calendar displaying your availability and complete session documentation in a timely manner within our scheduling system.
  • Use evidence-based treatment modalities and interventions that are tailored to your client’s needs.
  • Collaborate with our dedicated provider support team, our licensed clinical care navigation team, and our administrative care support team whenever you need assistance.
  • Provide culturally competent and empathetic care, upholding our values of diversity and inclusion for all races, ethnicities, and genders.

Who you are

  • You are properly qualified (licensed, if applicable) to practice counseling (as a: Psychologist, Psychotherapist, Clinical Psychologist, Social Worker, etc.) in São Paulo . We are not able to accept applications from anyone requiring clinical supervision.
  • You maintain active professional liability insurance at market rates in your approved jurisdiction (country of licensure).
  • English proficiency requirement: It is required that all global providers speak English at a conversational level and are able to complete a clinical interview and our onboarding process in English. It is not required that all global providers offer therapy sessions in English
  • You have a minimum of 3 years of independent clinical experience.
  • You have access to a computer or laptop, are comfortable with technology, and are tele-health competent.
  • You are available to offer some amount of monthly in-person availability for Spring Health members in São José dos Campos.
  • You have training and experience in evidence-based modalities of care such as CBT, DBT, EMDR, ACT, CPT.
  • You are comfortable with providing safety planning and intervention during situations where a client might present with higher risks.
  • You are committed to quality clinical care and want to expand your capabilities and increase your effectiveness by being informed of client progress or challenges.
  • You like working independently, but would also enjoy having the support of a team and opportunities for connections and collaboration with other providers and our master’s level clinical care navigators.

If you are applying to a hybrid role, please be aware that your own office space will be required.

Why you'll like working with Spring Health

  • You’ll set your own schedule to fit your professional and personal needs.
  • Work from anywhere, as long as you have a confidential, private location with stable internet.
  • No need to spend time marketing your practice, checking insurance eligibility, collecting fees, or submitting claims - we take care of the administrative work so that you can focus on clinical care.
  • Grow your ability to provide effective care through feedback from evidence-based measures that help you identify what is working with your clients.
  • Join a dynamic community where you will be supported, your work appreciated, and you’ll have the opportunity to help us shape the future of mental health care!

In addition to finding people who are truly excellent at what they do, we take our values at Spring Health seriously:

Mission First Removing every barrier to mental health, together.

Move Fast to Change Lives We build with urgency and intention.

Take Ownership We extend trust and hold ourselves accountable.

Embrace Diverse Teams & Perspectives We find strength in the diversity of cultural backgrounds, ideas, and experiences.

Science Will Win We will achieve impact by innovation and evidence based frameworks.

Candor with Care We are open, honest and empathetic.

Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. Spring Health is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

title: Network and Systems Administrator
description:
About Playtech

Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience.

As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: and

Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices.

Ready to grow your career in IT Infrastructure?

We’re looking for a hands‑on, motivated Network & Systems Administrator to support our growing IT environment in Brazil. This is a great opportunity for someone with solid experience who wants to deepen their technical skills, work with modern technologies, and be part of a global, collaborative team.

Job Description

Your Mission: You Will…

  • Support day‑to‑day operations of corporate networks, servers, and IT systems.
  • Configure and maintain LAN, WAN, VPN, and Wi‑Fi networks across offices and datacenters.
  • Install, upgrade, and troubleshoot hardware, software, and infrastructure components.
  • Investigate and resolve IT incidents reported by users, ensuring reliable service delivery.
  • Follow corporate security policies and contribute to maintaining a safe and compliant environment.
  • Assist in IT infrastructure projects, documentation, upgrades, and system improvements.
  • Collaborate with your Team Lead, peers, cross‑functional teams, and external vendors when needed.

Qualifications

What You Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related discipline is desirable but not essential.
  • Proven experience in network/system administration in a corporate environment.
  • Practical knowledge of routing, switching, Wi‑Fi networks and firewalls.
  • Experience with VPN solutions or ZTNA.
  • VMware or alternative vendor virtualisation experience.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure) – networking/security fundamentals are enough.
  • Good understanding of DNS, user/role‑based access control, and general IT security practices.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and communicate clearly with global teams.
  • You are fluent in English (written and spoken).

You’ll Stand Out If You Have…

  • Certifications such as Cisco/Juniper, Linux Admin, VMware, or Windows Admin.
  • Hands‑on experience with Meraki devices and Wi‑Fi controllers.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • A proactive, solution‑oriented mindset and willingness to continuously learn.
  • Experience working in a distributed or multinational environment.

Thrive in a Culture That Values…

  • Learning opportunities and support to grow into more advanced responsibilities.
  • A friendly, collaborative team that shares knowledge and works together across regions.
  • A stable environment where you can build long‑term technical expertise.
  • Flexibility, ownership, and trust in managing your work.
  • A respectful and inclusive workplace where your contribution truly matters.

Additional Information

HOW TO APPLY?

Along with your CV, please submit a short motivation letter outlining your experience in network and systems administration or related IT roles. You can add this directly in the “Message to the Hiring Manager” section when applying.

IT INFRASTRUCTURE TEAM

You’ll be joining a supportive and experienced team responsible for keeping Playtech’s core systems running smoothly. We work with a variety of technologies, collaborate globally, and value teamwork, reliability, and continuous improvement. It’s a great environment to grow your skills while working on meaningful technical challenges.

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome everyone and celebrate diversity across our teams.

title: Senior Developer
description:
ADP is hiring a Senior backend Developer - Java

You will start your day on a scrum call to sync up the sprint work and goal with your team. You will spend most of your day designing, developing and testing your code and supporting your team members. You will be able to deploy your code in production using automated continuous integration and continuous deployment.

You will work with product managers, analysts, architects, and engineers to plan, design, develop, test, and implement information technology solutions.

Hybrid work model, Porto Alegre Office location. It is necessary to live in the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Here's what you can expect on a typical day:

  • We'll start each day with a scrum, working together to understand responsibilities, ID any issues, and communicate coding priorities.
  • Working in two-week sprints, you must keep up with timelines and good coding standards. Your primary responsibility is to deliver features on time.
  • We don't code in a silo. You'll talk to everyone from the project manager to Quality Assurance and current customers to understand requirements and create a collaborative output.
  • We're always learning new codes and investigating open-source communities. Knowing what questions to ask is more important than knowing the right answers.

TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

  • Demonstrates advanced understanding and experience on web application development.
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience of the technologies Java;
  • Know best practices around software development, SDLC, unit testing, frontend performance tuning, be able to share this knowledge with others in the team.
  • Experience using CI and CD pipelines
  • Technical Analysis – analyzing systems, problems, programs, formulating solutions.
  • Technical Design – ensuring that all work undertaken is of sound design and fits in with the existing architecture.
  • Participates in requirements gathering and reviews, assesses technical feasibility, assists in defining solutions, and prepares development artifacts where required.
  • Conducts code walk through and reviews with team members.
  • Monitors changes in technology; remains up to date on current industry trends and internal architecture practices, principles, models and standards; trains technical staff on new technologies.

HOW YOU’LL STAND OUT:

  • Support production software operations, test and debug programs
  • Make a good use of the CI and CD pipeline
  • Self-taught worker: capable of learning and applying by himself
  • Self-guided worker: capable of working with different product teams with little supervision after the initial learning period
  • Strong collaboration skills: ability to establish good relationships with the stakeholders
  • Developer empathy: ability to empathize with developers, by being flexible in solution design without compromising best practices and standards.
  • Improvisation (lateral thinking): the ability to think across disciplines and existing boundaries (technologies/business/geographies)
  • Research: an inclination to continuous research inside and outside of the current focus fields.

*O modelo de trabalho adotado pela ADP é office based/presencial, com a possibilidade de trabalho em home-office por até duas vezes na semana.

Considerando que as atividades desempenhadas pelos ocupantes deste cargo envolvem acesso a informações altamente confidenciais e sensíveis de clientes da ADP e de seus respectivos empregados, a ADP reserva-se o direito de conduzir checagem de histórico, de tempos em tempos, conforme autoriza o Incidente de Recurso de Revista Repetitivo nº 01 do Tribunal Superior do Trabalho, mediante consentimento do candidato/trabalhador.

title: In-house Engineer
description:
Role: In-house Engineer

Global Opportunities

By joining a team of more than 7,000 people operating in over 60 countries, you will be part of an agile network of talented and ambitious individuals. We count on you to engage, connect, and collaborate with colleagues from around the world. Seize the opportunity to learn, create, and develop your potential with us.

About the Field Service Team

You will be part of the Brazil Field Service team. Our department is responsible for providing first-class field service and support 24/7. By joining us, you will have the opportunity to develop your technical and interpersonal skills through diverse and challenging opportunities.

About the Role: In-house Engineer

As our In-house Engineer, you will be part of a highly qualified team and will be responsible for providing technical and commercial support to our customers directly at their sites.

We currently have four openings available.

Candidates must be based in, or willing to relocate to, one of the following locations

or nearby areas:

  • Nova Lima, MG
  • Santa Bárbara, MG
  • Parauapebas, PA
  • Canaã dos Carajás, PA,
  • Belém, PA

Your Responsibilities

  • Work full-time at designated customer sites.
  • Serve as the FLS focal point at the customer’s site.
  • Coordinate the resolution of all open items between FLS and the customer, ensuring effective and timely closure.
  • Provide on-site basic technical and commercial support to assist customers in achieving maximum operational efficiency with their FLS equipment, including filters, thickeners, flotation cells, crushers, HPGRs, and mills.
  • Monitor the customer’s inventory as well as all other key operational aspects to ensure safe and reliable operations.
  • Relay updated technical and commercial information from the customer site to FLS customer support teams.
  • Support the customer and the FLS team during scheduled and emergency maintenance activities at site.
  • Identify, evaluate, and recommend products, parts, upgrades, and services that best meet customer needs.
  • Ensure the entire sales process aligns with customer requirements,
  • from the initial proposal to final delivery, within the agreed timeframe.
  • Develop strong and effective relationships and communication with customers.
  • Deliver technical and administrative field reports.
  • Maintain and update the CRM system and other control tools.
  • Promote a culture of personal and team/customer safety.
  • Work independently with limited supervision

What You Bring

  • Technical degree or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in the mining industry (desirable).
  • Good working knowledge of parts and maintenance of mining equipment such as Thickeners, Flotation Cells, Filters, HPGRs, Mills and Crushers
  • Intermediate English and/or Spanish (desirable).
  • Availability to reside in or near the cities listed above.
  • Availability to travel when required.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Solid knowledge of MS Office, Outlook, and CRM systems.

What We Offer

  • Market-competitive salary and benefits package
  • Health insurance.
  • Meal vouchers.
  • Bonus program.
  • Private pension plan.
  • Internal and international opportunities to develop your career.

As an equal opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality, promoting an inclusive environment. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees, the stronger our team. In our commitment to equal opportunities and the elimination of prejudice, we ask that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, number of children and photograph from your application materials.

Please note that we will be reviewing applications till March 30th, but the procees is going forward at he same time and can be closed earlier. so please apply as early as possible. Candidates will be contacted by email and phone.

References from unsolicited recruiters or agencies will not be accepted.

All applicants will be required to pass a medical, drug and alcohol test prior to employment.

FLSmidth requires that all individuals have their respective work visas. Otherwise, we will not be able to accept your application.

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining industry – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

Atuar junto às lideranças na gestão de conflitos, clima, engajamento, desenvolvimento de times e mitigação de riscos trabalhistas.

A Dori | Ferrara não realiza cobranças para a participação de processos seletivos e toda a nossa comunicação é feita através dos canais oficiais da empresa. Se receber qualquer mensagem solicitando pagamento ou dados de cartão de crédito, pedimos que não responda e entre em contato imediatamente com nossos canais oficiais de atendimento (redes sociais ou SAC ).

Em conformidade com a Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD), informamos que todos os dados pessoais fornecidos durante o processo seletivo serão utilizados exclusivamente para fins de recrutamento e seleção. As informações serão tratadas com confidencialidade, segurança e armazenadas apenas pelo período necessário para o processo, sendo posteriormente descartadas de forma segura.

Logs e Analytics;
